lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you for calling, this is Sam. How may I help you?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Hi, I need an invoice for my last purchase so I can claim it as a business expense.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Certainly. Can I have the email address on the account?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Sure, it is the one ending in office dot com.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thanks. I have generated the invoice and emailed it to you. It includes the tax details.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Excellent, I can see it in my inbox. Thanks for the quick help.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: You are welcome, have a great day.
